}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview==
*OEM: [[Lanner]] FW-7551 (A-SV1) :[[Intel Atom]] C2358 (2x 1.7GHz)
*The '''[https://www.lannerinc.com/products/network-appliances/x86-desktop-network-appliances/fw-7525 FW-7525]''' is a compact, fanless desktop network appliance that utilizes :[[Intel Atom]] C2000 series processors (codenamed “Rangeley”), including :Dual-core C2358 (A/B), Quad-core C2518 (C) or C2558 (D) . *Incorporating with multi-core performance and built-in [[Intel]] QuickAssist :crypto acceleration technology, '''FW-7551''' is designed for applications such :as vCPE, SD-WAN, edge security and network performance monitoring.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Intel Atom]] C2358 @1.7GHz (Dual-Core) *Memory: 8GB (DDR3 ECC SoDIMM) RAM *Storage: 8MB (CMOS Serial) Flash ([[Winbond]]), :2GB ''WinTec'' CompactFlash, 120GB (SATA 3.0) SSD *Network: 6x Gigabit Ethernet ports *USB: 2x USB 2.0 ports *Power: 12V, 3A via barrel
==Links of Interest== :[https://www.silver-peak.com/sites/default/files/infoctr/spec_sheet_edgeconnect_xs.pdf Spec. Sheet]
